entries.claim: Under fixed one-pixel replay, 16-32 px O2M assigned-positive sets were more persistent than 8-16 px sets while rank-only exchanges accounted for a larger share of assigned-set Top-1 flips.
entries.validity_notes: Discovery evidence. Rank and set are distinct estimands; undefined empty-set Jaccard and retention values are excluded rather than imputed.

entries.claim: Under equivalent-side kappa=0.0625 replay, 8-16 px O2M positive sets were more persistent than 16-32 px sets, while assigned-set Top-1 flips were lower and rank-only exchanges accounted for a larger share of tiny-object flips.
entries.validity_notes: Discovery evidence. Stress-contract reversal of set persistence requires joint interpretation with continuous boundary analysis; no causal redundancy claim is made.

entries.claim: Under fixed one-pixel replay, the O2O pre-conflict Top-7 q winner and final post-conflict assigned O2O identity had nearly identical scale gaps; every recorded flip or fragility disagreement coincided with the instrumented conflict stage.
entries.validity_notes: Conflict coincidence localises disagreement but is not a causal effect estimate.

entries.claim: Under equivalent-side kappa=0.0625 replay, the O2O pre-conflict Top-7 q winner and final post-conflict assigned O2O identity had similar scale gaps; every recorded flip or fragility disagreement coincided with the instrumented conflict stage.
entries.validity_notes: Conflict coincidence localises disagreement but is not a causal effect estimate.

entries.claim: Branch-specific stress divergence was present at all six physically archived stages spanning the first completed epoch to the final checkpoint while formal mAP changed substantially.
entries.multiplicity_status: descriptive trajectory; no predictive correlation claim
entries.validity_notes: Epoch0.pt is the first completed framework checkpoint, not random initialization. Checkpoints 100-280 were unavailable; no interpolation is permitted.

entries.claim: A compatible YOLOv10-S detector contract reproduced the normalized near-flat O2O response, reverse O2M response, and positive paired branch divergence.
entries.multiplicity_status: cross-architecture discovery replication; no architecture-invariance claim
entries.validity_notes: Replication across two compatible detector contracts, not proof of architecture invariance.

entries.claim: A deterministic independent NumPy implementation reproduced every audited continuous O2O boundary trajectory in the prespecified 30-image subset within the frozen fine-step tolerance.
entries.validity_notes: Formal instrument qualification, not a scientific effect estimate. The recursive 37-file output inventory passed with SHA-256 ebc455fee2acd9b5609743ebf705e330f55d5e7648554419e07472014b3c636f. The process loaded launch-time dataset helper hash 70a6868f6a4bf4c4aa051bcf6fa8d19d10a5360820bfb20f1d325a34f9720e41 before later sealed-mode-only governance changes; the referenced helper functions and boundary estimators were unchanged.

entries.claim: Across continuous equivalent-side replay through radius 0.125, the post-conflict assigned O2O identity had a larger restricted mean stability radius than each audited O2M rank definition; the O2O-minus-O2M gap was larger for 16-32 px than for 8-16 px focal objects.
entries.multiplicity_status: discovery analysis; no confirmatory multiplicity claim
entries.validity_notes: Continuous-radius discovery evidence. Base-undefined trajectories are reported separately rather than imputed; right censoring and competing boundary causes are retained. RMSR and endpoint evidence localise stability geometry but do not establish a causal training mechanism. All eight output hashes and recursive inventory SHA-256 80f83afaf76e8ecb8a565c6b52c40220ec55fb1ab9a50e3ec6ff96ff7af2e0f0 passed.

entries.claim: Among trajectories with an observed fixed-pair q-order crossing, the native active-relative margin was positively associated with the crossing radius; this conditional association was substantially stronger than its association with eligibility-boundary radius.
entries.multiplicity_status: discovery construct-validation analysis; no confirmatory multiplicity claim
entries.validity_notes: The margin-rho_R correlation is conditional on observed rho_R and is not a censoring-adjusted population correlation. The eligibility control uses a different observed-case set. This supports construct localisation, not causality, incremental held-out prediction, or intervention efficacy.

entries.claim: In the gated 300-image discovery extension, nonfocal O2O identity changes were rare overall and were observed only for focal-neighbor pairs sharing at least one native pre-conflict candidate claim in the base or shifted state; no changes were observed among nonsharing pairs in this sample.
entries.multiplicity_status: gated discovery extension; no confirmatory multiplicity claim
entries.validity_notes: Validated as gated discovery evidence only. Terminal semantic validation SHA-256 20c61db890954585c5518ab2ec730bbcddf8a7563a0e2696fea8ad41fd2aeacf reproduced all summary rates, all 5000 bootstrap replicates, and all intervals with zero numeric difference; recursive inventory SHA-256 32b0151767c7ed03300b22c351de7fd15b63eb88547fb7ce9a4c9e0921d9a7f1 passed. The data-YAML path was frozen but its hash was not prebound in CONFIG.json; matching preflight and post-run SHA-256 23fb59a4541db5f64a6c43e666b168872a5be48487ca7ce0c72033adeaf6413e is contemporaneous provenance only. Observed concentration in shared-claim pairs localises structural coupling but does not establish causality, exclusivity, equivalence, or absence of nonshared spillover in other samples.

entries.claim: In image-grouped out-of-fold sensitivity analyses, replacing a linear native margin term with a training-fold-fitted restricted cubic spline did not produce a stable metric-wide improvement for either O2O fragility or coverage-based miss; spline AUC and PR-AUC were no better, while the small log-loss differences had intervals spanning zero.
entries.multiplicity_status: supplementary descriptive sensitivity analysis; no confirmatory multiplicity claim and no equivalence claim
entries.validity_notes: Spline knots were estimated from weighted margin quantiles separately within each training fold and applied unchanged to held-out image groups. Terminal validation reproduced all 20 fold-model metric cells and both aggregate metric sets with maximum absolute difference 7.08e-14; 84/84 checks and recursive inventory SHA-256 6a59c30a69b0bee4b13ec6ce4c5bad710b95e00ffb514e377ff4886b2cc7c073 passed. This analysis does not establish causality, equivalence, or a best predictor.

entries.claim: In 1,000 outcome-blind stratified subsamples per image budget, 100 images recovered the sign and O2O-versus-O2M branch ordering of the full normalized paired contrast in all replicates, but its median absolute error was 3.43 percentage points and its 95th-percentile absolute error was 8.41 percentage points; reduced budgets therefore support dominant-signature screening rather than precise effect estimation.
entries.multiplicity_status: supplementary engineering analysis; no confirmatory hypothesis or multiplicity claim
entries.validity_notes: Terminal validation reproduced all five budget summaries and per-replicate error/sign identities with maximum absolute difference 5.56e-15; 48/48 checks and recursive inventory SHA-256 d9f63c73f4c121b82a9f00c4a0d4dc11db2cb2ff99ac12b399121ae3c4c3ce1c passed. No expensive nested bootstrap was performed. The result is not a sample-size recommendation, post-hoc power analysis, or precision guarantee.

entries.claim: A discovery-based 300-image precision-planning bootstrap estimated percentile 95% half-widths of 6.56, 5.53, 1.73, 2.78, and 2.58 percentage points for the prespecified H1, H2, H3, H4a, and H4b estimands, respectively; these estimates are planning diagnostics and not post-hoc power, minimum detectable effects, or precision guarantees for the sealed lockbox.
entries.multiplicity_status: prospective planning analysis only; no hypothesis test, power claim, or multiplicity decision
entries.validity_notes: The analysis used discovery outputs only and did not access sealed lockbox outcomes. Terminal validation passed 31/31 checks and recursive inventory SHA-256 d55fb59c901b12262d8c4e07e9f5477cc28f1ee6253c80c2f672fa7068a820d2 passed. The first validator attempt is retained under validation_history because it used 1.96 rather than the producer's exact Z_975 constant; correcting the validator did not rerun or alter experiment outputs.

entries.claim: After the prospective lockbox analyzer was irreversibly opened and invalidated by a support-contract defect, a separately labelled post-lockbox corrective analysis retained all 300 selected image clusters and used the disclosed 7,243-key fixed/normalized common-valid GT intersection. All five exploratory contrasts were in the preregistered directions, but none is a confirmatory verdict or formal hypothesis test.
entries.multiplicity_status: not applicable: prospective family invalidated before verdict; all reported H1-H5 analogues are post-lockbox exploratory and were not formally retested
entries.validity_notes: The normative prospective analyzer created receipt SHA-256 8a5eaee6703c75fec23ec287cf77db2f833a4d85540f21ac2c147b78a0464c83 and then failed before producing LOCKBOX_VERDICT.json. Prospective rerun is prohibited. The corrective analysis used a post-access support rule, so directional agreement cannot be claimed as confirmation. Independent terminal validation passed 23/23 checks, reproduced all five points exactly, and replayed all 5000 bootstrap values with maximum absolute difference 9.72e-17; recursive inventory SHA-256 d8121d884e2b68cbc095c04360392a1befcc18e6364b5795eff444a64e5a3619 passed.

entries.claim: On the frozen AI-TOD-v2 seed-0 discovery sample, fixed one-pixel replay produced a positive O2O 8-16 minus 16-32 px scale contrast, whereas equivalent-side kappa=0.0625 replay produced a near-zero O2O contrast and a negative O2M contrast; the O2O-minus-O2M paired branch contrast was positive under both contracts.
entries.multiplicity_status: frozen discovery comparison; no confirmatory multiplicity claim
entries.validity_notes: This claim registers pre-existing frozen discovery rows omitted from final_evidence_v1; it does not modify or retrospectively confirm them. Fixed and normalized contracts answer different perturbation questions, so their estimates are not pooled. The prospective lockbox yielded no normative verdict.

entries.claim: Across kappa=0.03125, 0.0625, and 0.125 on AI-TOD-v2 and VisDrone, equivalent-side O2M scale contrasts were negative and paired O2O-minus-O2M branch contrasts were positive, while the absolute O2O scale contrast varied with kappa and dataset.
entries.multiplicity_status: post hoc frozen discovery sensitivity grid; no confirmatory multiplicity claim
entries.validity_notes: This is a post hoc discovery sensitivity grid frozen before the final manuscript rewrite. It supports stability of the paired branch direction over the tested grid, not architecture invariance, a universal scale law, or confirmatory replication. The AI-TOD-v2 kappa=0.0625 row is shared with EV-STRESS-CONTRACT-PRIMARY-V1 and must not be double-counted.

entries.claim: On the prespecified 30-image convergence subset, 1/512 and 1/1024 grids shared all 4,408 trajectory keys and event-state classifications, but nine material localization or return-state mismatches occurred across four trajectories; the full-population primary grid was therefore fixed at 1/1024.
entries.multiplicity_status: not applicable to deterministic convergence qualification
entries.validity_notes: This fail-closed gate selects numerical resolution; it is not a model-effect estimate. The absence of fine-only events did not override the prespecified zero-material-mismatch rule.

entries.claim: On the complete 300-image 1/1024 grid, post-conflict assigned O2O identity retained a larger restricted mean cause-specific boundary distance than assigned-positive O2M across all six audited truncation radii; the O2O-minus-O2M gap remained larger for 16-32 px than for 8-16 px focal objects at tau=0.125.
entries.multiplicity_status: discovery analysis and prespecified tau sensitivity; no confirmatory multiplicity claim
entries.validity_notes: Supersedes EV-BOUNDARY-GEOMETRY-V2 for manuscript boundary claims. Base-undefined trajectories are excluded rather than imputed; right censoring and competing causes are retained. The terminal validator bound all six tau outputs to canonical event and curve SHA-256 values and PASS status.

entries.claim: Among trajectories with an observed fixed-pair q-order crossing on the complete 1/1024 grid, the native active-relative margin was positively associated with crossing radius and more strongly than with eligibility-boundary radius on its separately observed support.
entries.multiplicity_status: discovery construct-validation analysis; no confirmatory multiplicity claim
entries.validity_notes: Supersedes EV-MARGIN-RHOR-CONSTRUCT-V2 for manuscript boundary claims. Both correlations are conditional on observed cases and use different supports; neither is a censoring-adjusted population correlation. This is construct localization, not a causal or predictive claim.

entries.claim: Native/production/reference parity remained exact, and every audited assigned O2O identity in the 300 base states and 5,251 sampled directional states had positive normalized target-score mass; assignment alone is nevertheless not sufficient for positive loss weight in the executable edge case.
entries.validity_notes: Supports positive loss weight on the audited states while retaining assigned-identity terminology because assignment is not sufficient in general.

entries.claim: The four released files named best.pt record val=false, null embedded best_fitness/fitness, and zero-based epoch 280; seeds 0--2 have recovered post-training scan logs showing epoch-280 promotion, while seed 3 retains an explicit missing-log caveat.
entries.validity_notes: The filename is not evidence of online validation selection. Post-training selection and formal AP recheck used the same validation benchmark.

entries.claim: Full-support crude, K=3--7 overlap-support crude, and overlap-standardised estimates separate support restriction from count-composition standardisation; most Top-1 attenuation arose at the support-restriction step, while positive-set turnover remained large.
entries.validity_notes: Descriptive decomposition; neither restriction nor standardisation identifies a causal count effect.

entries.claim: The fixed-one-pixel paired branch contrast retained the same direction across every protocol-eligible released seed under a crossed four-seed and image-cluster bootstrap.
entries.validity_notes: Four top-level seeds remain a limited training-randomness sample; seed 4 failed the frozen initialisation rule.

entries.claim: The equivalent-area paired endpoint, positive-count difference, Top-1 turnover, and positive-set turnover retained their reported directions across every protocol-eligible released seed.
entries.validity_notes: Sensitivity across every protocol-eligible released seed. It does not extend eligibility-lock, first-divergence, or dense-boundary analyses beyond seed 0.
